body:
Some acceptance tests fail only when the machine is busy: in back-to-back runs, during agent runs, or with the app open. These limits are too tight:

- the stand-in agent's 2 s `task_timeout`
- 1 s checks, such as `board_acceptance.Board.test_task_only_changes_wait_for_no_agent_command`, which failed in a 69 s run
- 5 s wait loops

Done when the suite passes in 5 back-to-back runs with 16 workers, while each test still checks what it was written to check (for example, that a note doesn't wait for an agent's command).
title: tests: time limits that hold on a busy machine
